subject: NorthBridge demo — decision signal and next-step options
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: NorthBridge demo — quick recap & questions

Thanks for taking the time today, Liam — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap of what we covered and two small asks so we can make next steps as low-effort as possible: 

1) Recap (short):
- Goal you shared: reduce per-query inference cost by ~40% while keeping 95th percentile latency under 150ms for your search rerank workload.
- Proposed approach: Redwood dedicated inference with KV-cache + intelligent batching and a mixed-precision quantized model variant.
- Main unknowns: exact request size distribution (avg tokens) and any hard constraints for PII handling / retention windows.

2) Asks (two quick things):
- Can you share a sample token histogram (or approximate avg tokens per request)? Even a ballpark helps us size the Dedicated pool and pick a quantization profile.
- Would you be open to a short 15-minute call next week to walk procurement through packaging and an initial estimate? If helpful, I can propose two options: a conservative 2-GPU pilot or a 6-week evaluation with autoscaling.

Attached the slide deck from the demo and a one‑page pricing snapshot for the two options.

Thanks — if you prefer, feel free to reply with a single number for average input tokens and I’ll take it from there.

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0128
attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf, redwood-pricing-v2.pdf

From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@northbridge.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jul 2025 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NorthBridge demo — quick recap & questions

Thanks, Grace — deck looks good. I pulled a rough token average from our logs: about 65 tokens per request (95th ~210). Procurement is on board to review the pricing, but I need to confirm data retention constraints with legal (they flagged a couple of items).

I should have a clearer signal by early next week (July 7). Can you hold a 15-min slot on July 8 for procurement if needed?

—Liam
Liam O'Connell
Head of Search Engineering
NorthBridge AI
liam.oconnell@northbridge.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: NorthBridge demo — decision signal and next-step options

Hi Liam — quick nudge since I didn’t hear back after your note. Hope the legal check went smoothly. Two quick things so we don’t lose momentum: 

1) Feedback request (one line): From your perspective, is this worth pursuing (yes/no/need more info)? A single word helps us prioritize and keeps your inbox light.

2) Next-step options (pick one):
- Option A: 15-min procurement intro on July 10 (I’ll invite Sean to cover SLA/ops).
- Option B: Send a tailored estimate for a 2‑GPU pilot using 65 avg tokens (I’ll include expected latency and monthly cost).
- Option C: Not a fit — appreciate the honesty, I’ll close the loop.

If you’re swamped, reply with just A, B, or C and I’ll take care of the rest. I’ve reattached the pricing snapshot and included a HubSpot link for the deal if you want to add notes.

Thanks again — genuinely curious whether this meets your decision signal.

Best,
Grace
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
